definitions.gloss: beware of fire; fire safety; fire prevention
definitions.explanation: A warning phrase about fire safety. Most commonly heard as a call during traditional neighborhood fire-watch patrols, where volunteers walk through residential areas at night, clapping wooden blocks and calling out this phrase.

examples.japanese: 「{火|ひ}の{用心|ようじん}！」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I heard a voice calling "Beware of fire!"
In winter, there are fire-watch patrols.

examples.japanese: {拍子木|ひょうしぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち→打つ：01221_utsu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧「{火|ひ}の{用心|ようじん}、⟦マッチ→マッチ：02966_macchi⟧⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧⟦{火事|かじ}→火事：01283_kaji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}びかけた→呼びかける：06480_yobikakeru⟧。
examples.english: He called out "Beware of fire — a single match can start a blaze" while clapping wooden clappers.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
A phrase deeply embedded in Japanese culture. During the dry winter months, neighborhood volunteers ({夜回|よまわ}り) walk through residential streets at night, clapping {拍子木|ひょうしぎ} (wooden clappers) and calling out {火|ひ}の{用心|ようじん}. The full traditional call is often: {火|ひ}の{用心|ようじん}、⟦マッチ→マッチ：02966_macchi⟧⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧⟦{火事|かじ}→火事：01283_kaji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと (Beware of fire — a single match can start a blaze).

USAGE:
Also seen on signs and posters as a general fire-safety warning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {火|ひ}の{用心|ようじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見回|みまわ}り (fire-watch patrol)
- {火|ひ}の{用心|ようじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ポスター→ポスター：09598_posutaa⟧ (fire-safety poster)
